contract.precondition: CashDesk.allInstances()->exists(cd: CashDesk|cd = self.CurrentCashDesk) and self.CurrentCashDesk.IsOpened = true and (self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = true or self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = true)
contract.postcondition: result = true and Sale.allInstances()->exists(ns: Sale|ns.oclIsNew() = true and self.CurrentSale = ns and ns.IsComplete = false and ns.IsReadytoPay = false and ns.BelongedCashDesk = self.CurrentCashDesk and self.CurrentCashDesk.ContainedSales->includes(ns) and ns.Belongedstore = self.CurrentStore and self.CurrentStore.Sales->includes(ns))
